description: This file defines API routes for managing 'notes' in a FastAPI application, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes for authenticated users.

methods.name: models.Note _get_note_or_404(db: Session, note_id: UUID, user_id: UUID)
methods.description: Helper function to fetch a note by ID ensuring it belongs to the current user, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: list[NoteOut] list_notes( db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to list all notes for the current user, ordered by last update time.

methods.name: NoteOut create_note( payload: NoteCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new note for the current user.

methods.name: NoteOut get_note( note_id: UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve a specific note by ID, ensuring ownership.

methods.name: NoteOut update_note( note_id: UUID, payload: NoteUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to update the title and/or content of an existing note.

methods.name: None delete_note( note_id: UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a note by ID, ensuring ownership.
